company_info.name: Edgars Stores Limited (ESL)
company_info.geographic_coverage: Zimbabwe - 27 Edgars Stores and 36 Jet Stores nationwide

services_products.name: Edgars Stores
services_products.description: Quality fashion and convenient shopping at competitive prices for middle to upper-income families. Fashion merchandise with no compromise on quality, competitive credit offerings.

services_products.name: Jet Stores
services_products.description: Clothing, white goods, kitchenware, hardware and variety goods. Quality value and commercial fashion at competitive prices for lower to middle income families.

services_products.name: Carousel Manufacturing
services_products.description: Manufacturing division producing denim, ladies, mens, kids, corporate and workwear. Products for in-house retail chains, independent retailers and corporates.

services_products.name: Club Plus Microfinance
services_products.description: Micro finance loans to lower to middle income customers at competitive interest rates.

services_products.name: Financial Services
services_products.description: Retail debtors book management, insurance products including Hospital Cash Plan.

services_products.name: Edgars Club Zimbabwe
services_products.description: Loyalty program designed to benefit Edgars stores customers.

value_propositions: Leading Zimbabwean retailer offering high-quality and competitively priced clothing
One-stop shop for the whole family - men, women, and children
Exclusive, quality clothing, footwear, accessories, and genuine high-end beauty products
Financial services and credit offerings for customers

contact_info.address: ZB Life Towers 15th Floor, 77 Jason Moyo Avenue and Sam Mujoma, Harare

raw_content.main_page: Edgars Stores Limited is a leading Zimbabwean retailer offering high-quality and competitively priced clothing and merchandise. The Group is organized into three strategic business units: manufacturing, finance and retailing.

scraped_pages.excerpt: Welcome to Edgars Stores Limited - Leading fashion retailer in Zimbabwe
ESL established 1946, founded by Sydney Press
Retailing, Manufacturing (Carousel), Club Plus Financial Services
Head Office at ZB Life Towers, Harare
